newsitem.title: USA: First State debentures called at 101 pct.
newsitem.headline: First State debentures called at 101 pct.

text.p: First State Bancorp said it has called for redemption on April 30 its seven percent convertible subordinated debentures due November 1, 2003, at a price of 101 percent.
The debentures are convertible into First State's common stock at a price of $10.50 per share.
First State's stock was trading at 15 on Wednesday morning.

"Management believes that the majority of Debenture holders will choose to convert their debentures into common stock because of the difference between the conversion price and the market price of First State's common stock," said Michael R. Stanford, President and Chief Executive Officer.
